# scan_repo { #labdata.remote.scan_repo }

```python
labdata.remote.scan_repo(client, owner, repo, cfg, ref=None)
```

Catalog the result files one GitHub repository publishes.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**client**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Client](`labdata.github.Client`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Client to read with.

<code>[**owner**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Repository owner.

<code>[**repo**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Repository name.

<code>[**cfg**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Config](`labdata.config.Config`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Settings supplying the results directories and the reading side filters.

<code>[**ref**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Optional](`typing.Optional`)\[[str](`str`)\]]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [None]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Branch, tag or commit to read. Defaults to the repository's default branch.

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[List](`typing.List`)\[[Entry](`labdata.model.Entry`)\]]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   One entry per published result file or dataset, each stamped with the commit the repository points at. Empty, at the cost of a single request, when the repository publishes nothing.
